registration_anchor_rules: anchor_kind is resolved through did-method-adapter-registry.json registration_anchor_kind before any branch parsing; an unregistered value, including any did:web anchor, fails closed with unsupported_did_method.

This suite pins the anchor's role in the portable Control closure, not did:webvh cryptography. SCID derivation, entry-hash links, controller proofs, rotation authorization against nextKeyHashes and witness proof validity are verified by ak.vector.identity.did_webvh_v1_adapter.v1 over did-webvh-v1-fixture.json; the entries here carry native member names so no parallel vocabulary enters, and their proofValue bytes are fixture placeholders rather than real signatures.

webvh_registration closed-form checks: registration_did_operation.did_method equals webvh and matches the DID method; log_entries[i].versionId carries version number i+1 starting at 1; registration_did_operation.operation is canonically equal to the last log_entries element and its seq, when present, equals that terminal version number; every witness_records row names a versionId present in log_entries and each version has at most one closed {versionId, proof} record whose proof array covers that version's declared witness threshold; normalized_did_document.did equals registration_did_operation.did; the terminal entry proof verificationMethod is the did:key URL of terminal parameters.updateKeys[0].

webvh_registration derivation: did is registration_did_operation.did, version_id is the terminal entry versionId, method_history_head is sha256 over RFC 8785 JCS of the terminal entry, root_public_key_multibase is terminal parameters.updateKeys[0] and root_verification_method is that entry proof's verificationMethod. The normalized document holds the principal's own published keys and is never a root-key source.

did_key_registration derivation: the branch carries only anchor_kind and did. method_history_head is sha256 over the UTF-8 bytes of did, version_id is synthetic-did-sha256:<same hex>, and the root verification method and key are rebuilt from the multibase suffix alone.

The derived did, method_history_head and version_id MUST equal the PCR genesis initial_resolution values byte-for-byte, the derived root verification method and key MUST equal the genesis root producer material, and project(did) MUST equal account_id.principal_id.

Every check consumes only the evidence root and its explicitly referenced objects. No case supplies a current resolver result, a database projection or an Account Authority receipt, so the whole suite runs offline.
